Los Cabos — Storyboard

Creative review · 16 assets · before any rendering
Duplicate check: PASS — every asset has its own hero.
Only the highlights reel (Reel A) may repeat frames. Anything used twice is outlined in red.
Library rescan. 108 files, up from 95. 5 genuinely new — IMG_0523, IMG_0552, IMG_0617, IMG_0633, IMG_8868, all of them Bonnie. The other 8 are byte-identical re-sync duplicates and are held out (flagged red in NOT SELECTED).

Two new photos earn a place: IMG_0552 (Bonnie in the surf, arm out) takes the emotional post, and IMG_0617 (Bonnie in the tiled tunnel) takes the pin post — it's the best portrait of her in the library.

Also worth knowing: IMG_0617 is the same pink pineapple dress Bonnie wears in the group shot, which confirms the whole IMG_0613–0617 tunnel run is her, not a colleague as round 1 recorded. Those frames are now available.

Bonnie appears in 8 of 16 assets.
